description: This file defines the interface and constants for log output handling in the Zephyr RTOS, including flags, data structures, function prototypes, and macros for logging functionalities.

methods.name: log_output_msg_process
methods.description: Processes log messages into readable strings using the provided log_output instance, message, and flags.

methods.name: log_output_process
methods.description: Processes input data into a readable string with timestamp, domain, source, thread ID, level, package, data, and formatting flags.

methods.name: log_output_msg_syst_process
methods.description: Processes log messages into SYS-T format.

methods.name: log_output_ctx_set
methods.description: Sets user context for the log output instance.

methods.name: log_output_hostname_set
methods.description: Sets the hostname for the log output instance.

methods.name: log_output_timestamp_freq_set
methods.description: Sets the timestamp frequency in Hz.

methods.name: log_format_func_t_get
methods.description: Retrieves the function pointer for a specific log format type.
